decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy channels and costs little to carry, but no website evidence since 2019 leaves its value only partly revealed, so keeping the option open remains sensible.
The skin and hair supplement is cheap to maintain and fits the consumer health strategy, and although its sister products C and D were dropped, nothing yet shows its value is unlikely to be realized.

The valsartan generic survived the 2018 recall period, which suggests it was re-established, and keeping it costs little because it is a registered generic in in-house manufacturing, but its distance from the core offer and its tender-driven margins keep the risk of withdrawal substantial.

The OTC triptan fills a differentiated consumer health niche that justified a dedicated launch page, and the missing archived pages say nothing about its performance, so the option should be held while its uncertainty resolves.
